name: Azoth
detailed_description:
MASTER THE ELEMENTS. FORGE YOUR PATH. SURVIVE THE RITUAL.

Azoth is a strategic deckbuilding card game where you'll harness the powers of Blood, Sol, and Anima to overcome increasingly challenging rituals. Draw through your entire deck each round while building synergistic card combinations through a unique linking system that rewards careful planning and strategic play.

KEY FEATURES

UNIQUE LINKING SYSTEM Cards must be played in strategic links - sequential numbers, matching numbers, or elemental sets. Each card's valence number determines its minimum link requirement - the higher the valence, the more challenging it is to play, but the greater its power.

THREE PRIMAL ELEMENTS Command the powers of Blood, Sol, and Anima as you build your deck. Each element offers distinct play styles and synergies, allowing for countless strategic combinations.

RITUAL CHALLENGES Face a series of increasingly difficult rituals, each presenting a critical choice: face a greater challenge for valuable rewards, or take the safer path with no long term benefits. Every decision shapes your journey.

CHARACTER CLASSES Choose your approach to survival for each round with unique character abilities. Pay life to draw cards, discard strategically, rearrange your deck, or set up devastating combos by retrieving cards from your discard pile.

BATTLE CURSES Overcome curse cards that infiltrate your deck and disrupt your strategy. Each curse requires specific link patterns to defeat, adding another layer of tactical depth.

ENDLESS CUSTOMIZATION Enhance cards with powerful attributes that create exponential synergies.

FULLY FEATURED CARD CREATOR Design your own cards, rituals, and curses with the built-in card maker. Test your creations in custom runs and share them with the community.

GAMEPLAY

In Azoth, the goal is to draw through your entire deck during each ritual. Manage your limited life total carefully - it's both your survival metric and a resource for your character's special abilities. Sculpt the perfect deck, upgrade cards, attach attributes, and build powerful combinations to overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

Will you choose the risky path for greater rewards, or play it safe? With procedural generation ensuring no two runs are alike, each journey through Azoth offers new strategic puzzles to solve. Or, build your own constructed deck and face the ultimate challenges head on, testing your deckbuilding prowess.
